title.narrative: Summary of outcomes from regional stakeholder consultations and analytical work to facilitate preparation of a draft regional framework on plastic waste trade.
Summary of outcomes from consultations and draft regional framework on plastic waste trade completed.

target.value: Summary of outcomes from regional stakeholder consultations and analytical work to facilitate preparation of a draft regional framework on plastic waste trade completed and disseminated.

actual.value:
1) Regional stakeholder consultations and analytical work to build on a World Bank internal options paper on the regional plastic waste trade to facilitate preparation of a draft regional framework carried out.
2) Summary of outcomes from regional stakeholder consultations and analytical work to facilitate preparation of a draft regional framework on plastic waste trade is developed.

target.value: 1. TOR for Consultant/Firm developed. 2. Consultant/Firm contracted to carry out regional stakeholder consultations and analytical work for draft regional framework.
Summary of outcomes from regional stakeholder consultations and analytical work to facilitate preparation of a draft regional framework on plastic waste trade completed and disseminated.

actual.value: There is a delay in producing the summary of outcomes. The consultation process is expected to run until the end of 2023 with a final draft paper on a potential ASEAN framework/protocol/agreement on regional plastic waste trade expected to complete in Q1 2024.

title.narrative: Study detailing regional guidance on plastic standarts.
Study published and disseminated to support development of regional guidance to help ASEAN Member States in developing national standarts related to plastics.

target.value: A study to identify best practices for standards related to the responsible plastic waste trade, sorted plastic waste, recycled plastics, sustainable packaging, and labelling in ASEAN is completed.
Review of existing literature on sustainable plastic packaging and prepare the ToR for the study.

- Consulting firm for the study has been contracted and will carry out the following tasks: (i) identify global best practices; (ii) review existing standards in ASEAN; (iii) identify guiding principles and minimum technical information; and (iv) carry out regional consultation workshops with the public and private sector.
- The study completed and disseminated to the relevant SEA-MaP stakeholders by the end of the year.

actual.value: Firm had been contracted to undertake study and prepare regional guidance material. Delay in study completion which result in delay in the dissemination activities. Study dissemination delayed to Q2 2024.

title.narrative: Detailed study including recommendations on design and operation of ASEAN regional platforms for marine plastics - covering innovation and investment, and for knowledge and partnerships.
Detailed study including recommendations on design and operation of ASEAN regional platforms for marine plastics - covering innovation and investment, and for knowledge and partnerships is completed.

target.value: Detailed study including recommendations on design and operation of ASEAN regional platforms for marine plastics - covering innovation and investment, and for knowledge and partnerships is completed.

actual.value:
1) Stocktaking report, gap analysis, and proposed platform design and implementation roadmap report on existing knowledge sharing landscape in ASEAN are developed and consulted to the relevant stakeholders.
2) Stocktaking report, gap analysis, and proposed platform design and implementation roadmap report on innovation and investment landscape in ASEAN are developed and consulted to the relevant stakeholders.

target.value: Review of existing literature on plastic innovations in ASEAN; mapping out existing knowledge networks

actual.value: Litterature review, draft study and recommendations succeeded.

target.value: Conceptualizing platform content; initial stocktaking of existing relevant platforms.

actual.value:
The team has mapped out 2 existing platform in the region: Regional Platform on Knowledge and Partnerships & Regional Platform for Innovation and Investments.
The team has mapped out existing knowledge networks and completed initial conceptualization of the content of both platform.
